svg.title: Coroners Department — pointed shoulder patch
svg.desc: Source-backed clean vector reconstruction of the user-provided Coroners Department photograph. This pointed CORONERS / DEPT. edition is separate from S56-O44 BRITISH COLUMBIA / CORONERS SERVICE. Smooth manually designed border and authored condensed slab-serif captions follow the visible structure; exact original alphabet, stitches, edge fuzz, cloth texture and physical dimensions are unverified. The supplied compact framed deer/ram reference is uniformly fitted with native geometry and aspect preserved; fine embroidery differences and tiny motto details are not authenticated. Gold and white are intended clean thread colours, not colour-calibrated measurements.
